title: Venezuelan Skillet Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Venezuela, made with tender beans and a hint of zesty spices.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the black beans, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add a splash of water if the mixture becomes too dry.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a filling meal.
